steps.content:
18:00, November 29, N.F. 114
Viers Mansion, Eastside District 3
David Stewart Memorial Service
[Elegant, upbeat BGM plays]

steps.speaker: Attendant
steps.content: ...You're sent by the Cavendish family?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Yes. Ms. Cavendish sends her regrets that she cannot attend and has asked me to pay respects.

The attendant scrutinizes you, then glances down at the invitation in his hands, repeating this several times before letting out a derisive snort, either fueled by contempt for a political rival or disdain for your amateurish attire.
Nevertheless, he composes himself and steps aside with a respectful bow. At last, you make your way into the magnificent courtyard of the Viers Mansion in all its opulent splendor.

The ID verification process is meticulous, with security guards positioned along the path in significant numbers. While these measures would crumble against any Underground assault, they are notably thorough by the standards of high society's social gatherings.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: We have stationed guards in the surrounding blocks. However, the Stewarts rejected our earlier security warning.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: As Nightingale said, the Stewarts seem strongly opposed to any MBCC involvement. So she's unable to deploy additional personnel.

As the MBCC Chief, you did receive an official invitation. However, to avoid any potential political leverage during the election season, you declined the invitation and instead chose to attend in disguise under Cavendish's invitation name.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now I look perfectly like an unremarkable bodyguard, do I?
A soft chuckle comes through from the other end of the call.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Nightmare is positioned right outside the mansion. I'll provide immediate backup if anything happens.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Got it. Thank you Hecate.
After the exchange with Hecate, you enter the main building of the mansion.

Amidst melodious music and the aroma of fine delicacies and wine, this grand hall exudes magnificence—every detail reflecting the host's status and refined taste. The space bustles with guests exchanging pleasantries and information, all expressing their approval of this gathering.
—It hardly resembles a memorial service, but no one here seems to care anyway.

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest A
steps.content: Terrible timing, huh? The corporation had just greenlit the funding for him before he kicked the bucket. If only this happened a little sooner or later, we wouldn't be in this mess.

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest B
steps.content: What about the West District? I heard they're making demands about voting rights again...

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest A
steps.content: Oh please. If we let them in now, we can kiss the new mine goodbye forever. Even the Stewarts can't keep 'em in check. Who else could possibly—

steps.speaker: Distinguished Guest B
steps.content: What about that MBCC Chief? He wields quite a bit of influence, doesn't he? The Stewarts sent him an invitation as well. If we could rope him in, we might just...
steps.female_content: What about that MBCC Chief? She wields quite a bit of influence, doesn't she? The Stewarts sent her an invitation as well. If we could rope her in, we might just...

steps.content: While these "refined" social elites carry on with their agitated and uninhibited chatter, you stand right behind them, sipping lemonade from a wine glass and adjusting your sunglasses.
Despite your miserably poor disguise, no one has seen through it yet. Apparently, these high-class people don’t care about you as much as they claim.
Or perhaps you should thank some others for attracting the spotlight—after all, even you find your gaze drawn to them.
[Big CG]

Under the dazzling crystal chandeliers and surrounded by the lavishly-dressed crowd, two ladies in black stand close together, captivating all gazes and sparking whispered conversations. Among them, you immediately recognize Elvira Stewart.
Bernadette mentioned she just turned sixteen, but she appears much smaller and frailer than her age would suggest, seemingly even more timid than in her photo.
You focus on the audio feed in your earpiece. After entering, you have carefully selected several targets in the crowd and planted listening devices on them.
As luck would have it, one of your targets is positioned close to Elvira. You tune into the corresponding channel to monitor the situation.
However, what comes through the channel is far from pleasant.

steps.speaker: Leading Man
steps.content: Still no words, huh? Prime Minister's death is a loss, but this isn't over. You owe us the truth.

steps.speaker: Leading Man
steps.content: Your father came to see you the night before it happened. What was that for?
The crowd surrounds her like vultures, their downward gaze oppressive as they press for the girl's answers.

steps.speaker: Leading Man
steps.content: Better be honest with us, young lady. Do you really think the Stewarts can protect you forever?
While the young girl remains silent, the pale-faced woman standing before her steps in.

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: Mr. Stewart was so devoted to his duties that he rarely came home. He was a man of discretion and confidentiality, never bringing his work home.

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: Thank you for your concern for our young lady.

steps.speaker: Leading Man
steps.content: ...I was asking Miss Stewart.

steps.speaker: Woman in Black
steps.content: The young lady gets distressed whenever speaking of her father. This may not be the most opportune time. We will make sure to pay you a proper visit once she's ready.
Her voice gentle, yet her words carry unmistakable firmness as she subtly positions herself between the girl and the hostile gazes of the crowd.
Meanwhile, another messsage cuts in through your earpiece.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Chief, we've got some info on that lady. She's a <color=#fb9259>butler</color>, secretly hired by Stewart to look after his daughter.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Stewart kept them under wraps. So all we've found out for now is her name—<color=#fb9259>Jelena</color>.
That explains the woman's behavior—she's simply carrying out her duties.

steps.speaker: Distant Crowd
steps.content: With such a grand reception tonight, isn't it the Stewarts' wish to introduce their secret young lady? Disregarding your employer's wishes wouldn't be the smartest move, I'm afraid.

steps.speaker: Distant Crowd
steps.content: Don't upset those in charge, miss, or you might be fired. You don't want things to look bad, do you?

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: You are indeed correct. I must exert every effort to retain my job.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Mr. Stewart had specified in his will that should anything unexpected occur, he wanted me to continue to care for El as her legal guardian.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Therefore, unless directed otherwise by the court, I will uphold an amicable relationship with the Stewarts. I am committed to fulfilling my responsibilities till the end.
The butleress responds with a composed smile, defying the expected submissive demeanor. Her calculated arrogance riles up the crowd, capturing all their attention.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...She's protecting the girl.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Yes. We've heard that when the Stewarts "picked up" the girl from her residence, they had a brutal clash with the staff there. All the guards were forced to leave, while she was the only one staying by Elvira's side.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Was she injured? 'Cause there's something off about her moving. She's trying to act normal but... is she's trying to hide her wound from the girl?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Truly one of strength she is—resolute and loyal to the core.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Our radical Prime Minister himself hand-picked her to protect his daughter. She must be very trustworthy.
But apparently, the people behind you hold a different perception of her.

steps.speaker: Bystander Behind
steps.content: I bet she's David Stewart's lover. Heh, a woman with that kind of history, watching over his illegitimate daughter—she's really out of her league here.

steps.speaker: Bystander Behind
steps.content: Quite a looker, though, just the type men would go crazy for. No wonder Stewart kept her under wraps. Seems like our Prime Minister has his own share of dirty laundry... Now that's the story someone should dig into.
You frown, disgust welling up inside you. Yet these vulgar topics quickly capture the interest of the supposedly refined elites.

steps.speaker: Bystander Behind
steps.content: No wonder. Any woman who caught the Prime Minister's eye must be quite something. Surely she won't tell you anything if you ask her straight out, but...

steps.speaker: Bystander Behind
steps.content: If it were me there, I'd play it like this—
While the woman continues, you catch someone in the distance echoing the same venomous words through your earpiece, almost as if on cue.

steps.speaker: Distant Crowd
steps.content: You must really care about Ms. Jelena, right, El? Ah, how sweet to have such an intimate maid. Unfortunately it'll be just the two of you in the future, almost like a widow and her daughter...

steps.speaker: Distant Crowd
steps.content: Would you call her mother when it's just you two, little lady?
The approach proves very effective as Jelena's voice grows evidently heavy with tension.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: This must be a misunderstanding. Miss Stewart's mother is someone else entirely.

steps.speaker: Distant Crowd
steps.content: Oh, please. You're so caring for Mr. Stewart's daughter, he must've felt so indebted to you... He's not one to trust easily—didn't have a wife yet kept a beauty like you by his side...

steps.speaker: Distant Crowd
steps.content: What happened to him was truly tragic. It's a rare chance we're all here tonight, you can tell us your story. We're so concerned about you and... the girl's mother.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Please step back. El's mother was—

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Jelena is not my mother!
The girl's abrupt outburst plunges the room into a profound silence. Still standing behind Jelena, she struggles to hold back tears, her face flushed with emotion.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: My mother... She went to heaven... a long, long time ago. I've been waiting for her to come back and see me.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Jelena has been with me all the time. She has nothing to do with my father. She promised to stay by my side until Mother comes back.
The guardian places a gentle hand on the frail girl's shoulder. She trembles at the touch, her voice growing softer.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: Sob... I...

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: I'm not lying! J-Jelena is not my mother! Don't you be mean to her!
There's something off about her demeanor—her words come out disjointed, her expression somewhat unnatural.
After a moment of silence, a clamor erupts in the banquet hall, resonating like a thunderclap.

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: She can't speak. Hey look at her! She can't even speak properly!

steps.speaker: Crowd
steps.content: No wonder David never brought her to the family. Oh, I'm almost feeling sorry for him!
Their blunt laughter of mockery instantly engulfs the two of them. You feel your blood boiling with anger.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Aren’t they the Prime Minister’s family? Isn’t the girl Stewart’s own flesh and blood? What are these people even—
Soon, your eyes find the patriarch of the Stewart family—the late Prime Minister's brother and the host of this service.
His face appears gloomy as he watches everything unfold in silence, yet a twisted smile creeps across his lips.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Bastard... Did he arrange this just to humiliate his brother's child? What a piece of trash.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Chief, stay put.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: They aren't in any immediate danger. You can't risk exposing yourself. Please keep still.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: The Stewarts aren't like other houses. Though they're waning, their influence still runs deep. Even our superiors have to be cautious dealing with them. Don't confront them directly.
You clench your fists tightly, watching in silence as the crowd grows more restless.

steps.speaker: Distant Crowd
steps.content: Hey, what did your father tell you? Holding high hopes for you, did he? Or was it all just lies? Did he ever love you?

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: D-don't come... Go away...

steps.speaker: Leading Man
steps.content: What are you asking those kinds of questions for?! You’re scaring her; we still need her to cooperate and tell the truth!

steps.speaker: Distant Crowd
steps.content: Truth? From a moron? I say we just ask her who her real mother is!

steps.speaker: Distant Crowd
steps.content: Even in death, he's so pathetic. Stewart's glory days are long gone. His supporters must be crying their eyes out—

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Please stay back.
The butler shields the young girl, visibly struggling to contain her fury.
You know all too well how difficult it is to maintain composure at a time like this.

steps.speaker: 9th
steps.content: Chief, hang in there. We'll find a way to help you. Just a bit more patience, please.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know...
But I'm about to lose it.

steps.speaker: Elvira
steps.content: *Dry heaves.*

The prolonged stress, combined with the overwhelming pressure of the current situation, finally breaks the young girl. She collapses to the ground retching, tears streaming down her face, only to elicit even more vicious mockery from the crowd.

steps.speaker: Onlooker
steps.content: Oh, now she's puking? Look at her, this girl needs a mommy! Anyone who knows how to babysit?

Unable to bear it any longer, you push through the crowd. Your mind races through potential options: evacuate the two in your current disguise as a security guard, demand action from the Stewart family head, or simply pull out your credentials to intimidate these people.
Just then, an unusual disturbance jolts you back from your seething anger.
—A killing intent, and a wave of Mania, fleeting yet formidable. This is...

steps.speaker: Onlooker
steps.content: Ahhh...!

The massive crystal chandelier abruptly comes crashing down, followed by the appearance of several dark figures. Before anyone can make out the situation, the woman who had laughed the loudest has her throat slit.
And the killer turns out to be...

steps.speaker: Onlooker
steps.content: M-monster!!

More Puppets burst in through the windows like a savage pack, sending the noble guests screaming and scattering in all directions. Their blades pierce through anyone in their path, but their true targets are those two—

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: El!
Nightmare crashes through the window wall, its power tearing apart the Puppets lunging at the pair. As the debris rains down, Jelena pulls Elvira into her arms, and then—
Almost instantly, she spots you among the fleeing crowd, her eyes locked with yours.
That woman can see Nightmare, and out of instinct, starts searching for its summoner. Before you can fully grasp the situation, you see the most desperate cry for help in her eyes—

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: ...Save her, please.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Enemy contact! Let's move! Nightmare, follow me to protect the targets!
